rules.statement: A tenant is entitled to recover possession from persons who have disturbed his possession without the necessity of making the landlord a party to the proceedings, and similarly, the plaintiffs, to whom the Society had conveyed its admitted rights of management and possession, are entitled to maintain an action for the assertion and recovery of those rights as against those who disturbed such rights.
rules.supporting_quote: Just as a tenant is entitled to recover possession from persons who have disturbed his possession without the necessity of making the landlord a party to the proceedings (Wile-Landlord and Tenant in South Africa- 4th Edition p. 145), the plaintiffs, to whom the Society had conveyed its admitted rights of management and possession, have a status to maintain this action for the assertion and recovery of those rights.
